item.summary: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated eight Canadian money services businesses on 6 November 2026 for helping move value involving Iran and related sanctioned actors through digital assets, according to the Treasury press release. OFAC said some of the firms also handled digital-asset transfers linked to Canadian drug trafficker Ryan Wedding. The designations are part of what Treasury calls Operation Economic Outcast.
